responses:
It describes someone who gives opinions on subjects they don’t really know about—especially with unjustified confidence.

It comes from a Latin phrase meaning “beyond the shoe,” traditionally linked to a painter who told a shoemaker to criticize only the shoes, not the rest of the artwork.
